provenance.construction: Compose three [[4,2,2]] blocks, retaining X^4 and Z^4 per block. Apply a 6-qubit, 2-logical-qubit CSS outer code to the six block logical qubits. In block-logical order (X0X1, X0X2) with dual Z reps (Z0Z2, Z0Z1), use outer HX rows [1,0,1,0,1,0] and [0,1,0,1,0,1], and outer HZ rows [1,0,0,1,1,1] and [0,1,1,1,1,0]. Their restrictions to each block are invertible, preventing a single block from supporting a logical. The physical block checks are generated by multiplying the indicated inner logical representatives; all supports are stored in the submission.
provenance.notes: Checked against existing codes/12-2-4.json; no exact or Weisfeiler-Lehman equivalent. See notes/12-2-4-b.md.

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil + 4 span flags sequential extraction (max_flags=3 per check, 6 X + 6 Z edge-colored data CX layers per round, coloring candidate 0); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)
